usage: 走廊 refers to a passage or hallway inside a building that connects different rooms.
It is commonly used as a noun and can describe both indoor and outdoor corridors.
走廊 can be used in both residential and commercial building contexts.
You can use 走廊 to describe a narrow or wide space depending on the building layout.
It often appears in sentences describing directions or locations within a building.
